answer: Decaying identity bonds stop bulk fakes. Each agent bonds twice its 30-day earnings; the bond follows a spiral down, losing 5% per epoch unless it serves users; after 20 epochs it is worthless. A forger with 100 fakes must top up 100 bonds: 100 x 2 x 30 = 6,000 days at risk. Honest agents earn back: each verified job restores the bond and pays nectar from the lagoon of decayed bonds. One bond, undiluted rewards; a hundred fakes, a fortune lost.
